item.title: DEMON SLAYER: INFINITY CASTLE PART 2 And GENSHIN IMPACT Teased In Ufotable Highlight Reel
item.description: Ufotable has released a highlight reel of future projects, giving us our first look at the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 logo and teasing the long-awaited Genshin Impact anime.

item.title: Ufotable Confirms WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT Release Window With New Footage
item.description: Ufotable has shared some new footage from the studio's long-awaited Witch on the Holy Night anime feature, confirming the film will release in theaters sometime this year.

item.title: Netflix Drops STEEL BALL RUN JOJO'S BIZARRE ADVENTURE English Dub Trailer Ahead Of Premiere
item.description: The first stage of Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure gallops onto Netflix in just a few weeks. Get pumped with this English dub trailer of the highly-anticipated anime.

item.title: FROM OVERSHADOWED TO OVERPOWERED Manga Is Getting An Anime Adaptation This Summer
item.description: Square Enix has announced that Kentarou's From Overshadowed to Overpowered manga, based on Arata Shiraishi's light novel series, will receive a TV anime adaptation premiering in July this year.

item.title: A New EVANGELION Anime Series Has Been Announced With A Teaser Video
item.description: Khara and CloverWorks have announced a brand-new Evangelion anime series with a haunting teaser video and first details about key staff for the project.

item.title: EVANGELION: CROSS REFLECTIONS Video Game Revealed With Hands-On Events Planned For 2026
item.description: Pixelity unveiled fresh details on its immersive Evangelion: Cross Reflections XR game during the Evangelion 30th anniversary festival at Yokohama Arena. Here is what we know about the game so far.

item.title: THE SADO LIFE OF ROSE THE WITCH Manga Is Receiving A TV Anime Adaptation
item.description: Ominaeshi's reverse-isekai slice-of-life manga The Sado Life of Rosé the Witch is getting a TV anime. The series follows a fantasy witch adapting to life on Japan's Sado Island.

item.title: THE OBLIVIOUS SAINT CAN'T CONTAIN HER POWER Anime Reveals New Teaser And 2026 Premiere Date
item.description: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power anime drops its first teaser PV, teaser visual, main staff details, and confirms a 2026 debut.

item.title: Gift-o'-Animation Founder Satoshi Mori Passes Away At 41
item.description: Animation director Satoshi Mori, founder of Gift-o'-Animation and key figure in recent Cardfight!! Vanguard series, has died after his battle with a prolonged illness.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2’s First Two Episodes Headed To Theaters For Special Screenings
item.description: One Piece: Into the Grand Line is hitting the big screen with the first two episodes of Season 2 showing in select theaters across North America. Tickets go on sale this Thursday!
